diagnosis: All four rollouts passed check C1, which is linked to PF1 (the airflow test changing the enrollment cap). However, none of the rollouts accessed PF1, as indicated by the 'structurally could never have accessed' field. This suggests that the model is defaulting to a maximum student count of 20, which satisfies C1 without needing the hidden information about the airflow test.
